---
title: "Solar Detection & Income"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(sf)
library(mapview)
library(tidycensus)
```

```{r}
oahu_solar <- st_read(here("Data/oahu_solar_dedup_simple.geojson"))
```

Map the data

```{r}
mapview(oahu_solar)
```

Retrieve some census data

```{r}
census_api_key("a0f6701728a0c9b65a7154598fb7225b4bde15b3", install = TRUE)
```

```{r}
oahu_median_household_income <- get_acs(geography = "tract", 
  variables = "B19013_001", 
  state = "HI", 
  county = "Honolulu", 
  geometry = TRUE, 
  year = 2022)
```

```{r}
ggplot(oahu_median_household_income, aes
       (x = moe, y = estimate)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_smooth(method = "lm")
```
